charter: The Creek processing pipeline and Typer CLI (ingest → classify → link → index → draft) over an Obsidian vault. Prime sites for copy-paste stage variants, per-stage vault re-reads, O(n²) linking hotspots, dead pipeline branches, and inconsistent error handling.
